changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO finances.stock_types (user_id, name) SELECT u.id, v.name FROM system.users u CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('Ações'), ('FII'), ('ETF')) AS v(name) WHERE u.email = 'admin@admin.com' ON CONFLICT (user_id, name) DO NOTHING;
